description: Source code for NuMediaExtractor class implementing media extraction functionalities in Android's stagefright framework.

classes.name: NuMediaExtractor
classes.description: Class implementing media extraction functionalities, including track selection, reading samples, and handling different data sources.

methods.name: setDataSource
methods.description: Sets the data source from a URI with optional headers, detects Widevine streams, and initializes the extractor.

methods.name: setDataSource
methods.description: Sets the data source from a file descriptor, offset, and size, and initializes the extractor.

methods.name: updateDurationAndBitrate
methods.description: Updates total bitrate and duration based on track metadata.

methods.name: countTracks
methods.description: Returns the number of tracks in the media source.

methods.name: getTrackFormat
methods.description: Retrieves the format information for a specified track.

methods.name: releaseTrackSamples
methods.description: Releases samples for all selected tracks.

methods.name: fetchTrackSamples
methods.description: Fetches the next sample from each selected track, considering seek position.

methods.name: seekTo
methods.description: Seeks to a specified time in the media.

methods.name: advance
methods.description: Advances to the next sample in the selected tracks.

methods.name: readSampleData
methods.description: Reads the current sample data into a buffer.

methods.name: getSampleTrackIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the track index of the current sample.

methods.name: getSampleTime
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the current sample.

methods.name: getSampleMeta
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for the current sample.

methods.name: getTotalBitrate
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total bitrate of the media.

methods.name: getCachedDuration
methods.description: Returns cached duration if available, considering Widevine or cached source.
